verdict.rationale: A keyless probe confirms https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt is live and indexes a full grok-bot docs section of 21 pages, each fetchable as raw markdown. The docs-md probe's 404 was a double-.md URL artifact; overview.md itself returns text/markdown. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is shared with the broader SpaceXAI API docs rather than being Grok Bot-specific, and there is no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance beyond the markdown index.
